author: Nick Y.
text: Scott came out to pump our septic and did a great job. Super professional and efficient. He was also very knowledgeable and I appreciated chatting about our septic system and learning some things from him. Thanks a bunch, Scott and Lil John!

author: Larson Log Trucking
text:
This business flat out refused to service a port a potty.
She thinks she's some kind of comedian and offered to do it herself for $400.
Boy I'd pay that just to watch her do it!!
What a poor attitude, non helpful employee to cost this company legitimate income by refusing to do certain types of septic services.
I believe a licensed & permitted sewer waste company has a community obligation to come vacuum up and properly dispose of human waste
This company doesn't care about the community in which they serve.

author: Kelsey Riley
text: Our construction company uses LJ Portables for many of our jobsites. They are quick to respond to requests and make billing easy by charging monthly. We will gladly continue working with them and highly recommend!

author: Bryan Cademas
text: Scott is awesome and did a great job!

author: Matt Langstraat
text:
I have hired them for both personal and business, and they always serve me well!  I've had my septic tank pumped and the driver was very kind and professional, and gave us very good information after the inspection.
Their portable toilets are always clean, and they are always flexible on delivery dates, and at times can help on short notice!

A great local business!
